lede: Ole Miss carries the stronger underlying team rating — +12.1 against +2.6, a 9.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Florida +4.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ole Miss winning 63% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is special teams, where Florida leads Ole Miss by 97 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
